posts.title: lifelog: Cron, Files and SQL as Memory for My Agents
posts.description: Every agent session starts with amnesia. lifelog pulls my calendar, mail, Slack, Linear, GitHub, journal and agent sessions into raw JSONL, projects them with DuckDB at read time, and hands any agent a deterministic brief of what happened lately.
